name.zh: 一辉公开求婚誓约与战争条件
name.en: Ikki's Public Marriage Pledge and War Condition

periods.location: Vermillion royal castle dining room and balcony
periods.summary: Lunaeyes exposes Sirius's plot using the bounty poster and a hidden national broadcast setup. Stella breaks down because her family and people may have made Ikki hate her homeland, but Ikki tells her he loves Vermillion because its people love and protect her. He formally asks Stella's family to test his resolve and eventually give Stella to him. Lunaeyes then sets the condition: Ikki must join Vermillion's upcoming war against Quedolan and bring the nation victory.
periods.cause: Ikki reaches the castle despite the national pursuit, forcing Sirius's scheme into the open and requiring a formal resolution of his relationship with Stella.
periods.process: Lunaeyes presents the bounty poster; Sirius is punished by his family; Stella cries in anger and grief; Ikki comforts her and states that he wants to become part of Vermillion's family. He pledges before Stella's family that his love will not lose to anyone. Lunaeyes reveals she has broadcast the conversation to the nation and asks the citizens whether they object. They accept him and support the war condition.
periods.outcome: Sirius, the royal family, and citizens agree in principle to accept Ikki if he helps win the Vermillion-Quedolan war; Ikki publicly promises to do so.
periods.significance: Transforms Ikki from outsider under attack into accepted candidate for Stella's husband and connects the romance plot to the international war plot.
